A '''revolt''' undertaken by [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individuals took place on [[Qaras]] in [[44 ABY]], inspired by revolts of [[Octusi]] and [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]]. The Jessar population, enslaved by the [[Minyavish]], were aided by [[Freedom Flight]]. Guided by their leader, [[Rokari Kem]], they overthrew the Minyavish.
